deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds that the stained slice through a tumour 'illustrates this', linking the figure to the preceding sentence about biologists explanting tumours, whereas the text does not state that the slice illustrates explanting tumours.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: The word 'really' in 'really don't grow' acts as conversational emphasis rather than a scientific hedge, so changing it to 'do not grow' does not improperly remove a hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: throw it into a plastic tissue culture dish
considerations.reason: 'placed in a plastic tissue culture dish' is an allowed stylistic rendering of the colloquial phrasing 'throw it into'.

considerations.sourcePassage: contributions of things like the stroma and other things
considerations.reason: 'other components' accurately captures 'other things' in the context of the stroma and tumour microenvironment.

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: This is an omitted remark to the audience/speaker's self, which is an allowed change.
